font.reason: Its variable weights, Persian glyph coverage, and restrained product UI tone match the source's clean research card wall. FaRoot loads it before render.

DeckDealFlyin.what: Project card grid and stagger order
DeckDealFlyin.action: Reflect each card x as 1920 - x - width, then sort each row from right to left before assigning the original cue formula.
DeckDealFlyin.why: The first project belongs at the rightmost position in Persian reading order; the 26-card accelerating sequence still begins on frame 36 and uses the original cue intervals.

DeckDealFlyin.action: Reflect the pile position and the top card's 30 px pull while preserving the 48 px downward press.
DeckDealFlyin.why: The pile must launch toward the mirrored grid; gravity and the anticipation magnitude are unchanged.

DeckDealFlyin.action: Reflect opening camera x offsets and the horizontal orientation angles, keep the original vertical positions, zooms, perspective, frame keys, and easing.
DeckDealFlyin.why: The orbit and chase retain the source's silhouette while following the RTL card flow.

DeckDealFlyin.action: Replace every raster card, including the flying ghost, with an opaque Persian React card; right-align dates, titles, descriptions, metadata, and tags.
DeckDealFlyin.why: The source card PNGs contain baked-in English and Chinese, and card details must stay legible during the opening close-up.

DeckDealFlyin.action: Cover the source page raster with an opaque Persian page, placing the search field at the right and the filter control at the left.
DeckDealFlyin.why: The page texture has baked-in foreign text; navigation and form order follow RTL reading order.

DeckDealFlyin.action: Keep FaRoot's camera container LTR and set explicit RTL on PersianPage and PersianCard.
DeckDealFlyin.why: Inheriting RTL into PageCam2D shifts its auto-positioned zoom transform and moves the pile off-screen.

DeckDealFlyin.what: Depth, gravity, texture, shadows, and paper extension
DeckDealFlyin.action: Keep their original vertical/z behavior, physical shading, dimensions, and material gradients.
DeckDealFlyin.why: They describe physical motion and lighting rather than reading direction.

DeckDealFlyin.action: Use Persian digits for all visible dates and counts; retain CI as a conventional technical token.
DeckDealFlyin.why: Project UI counts should read naturally in Persian without changing technical meaning.

rasterHandling.projects-empty.png: Fully covered by an opaque PersianPage at the same 1920 by 1746 page coordinates; its English and Chinese labels never show in localized frames.
rasterHandling.card1.png through card10.png: Replaced by PersianCard for all 10 original cards and 16 repeated extras. The same replacement is used for motion-blur ghosts. Source images are not rendered visibly.
rasterHandling.metal: CSS brushed-metal material retained; it contains no text.

unchanged: camera frame keys and zoom values
motionFidelity.textTiming: The source has no typewriter or text-driven stagger; Persian copy length does not move any cue or camera beat.

verification.method: Viewed matching original and Persian stills at the opening, anticipation, first deals, chase, and resting grid. The mirrored stack, card destinations, typography, and lack of visible source text were checked.

concerns: The source card textures are raster facsimiles with very small text. Persian React cards preserve their hierarchy and geometry, but condensed Persian descriptions and web-font metrics change microspacing within the cards.

lessons.symptom: A mirrored card camera rendered only its metal table at the opening and shifted the final grid rightward.
lessons.cause: An RTL parent changed the auto placement of PageCam2D's zoomed, absolutely positioned camera plane.
lessons.fix: Keep the camera coordinate wrapper LTR; reflect page-space x values deliberately and give only the actual page and card surfaces direction: rtl.
